paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Yeshayah HaBosem, a Tanna.
Mentioned in Tosefta Sheviit, chapter 5, and Chullin, chapter 3, testifying before Rabbi Akiva in Rabbi Tarfon's name.
We find Rabbi Oshaya, his son, in Chullin 55a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “His son” follows the heading’s subject. The Tosefta chapter references and the testimony before Akiva in Tarfon’s name remain distinct.

The consulted Bavli places Rabbi Oshaya’s testimony on Chullin 55b and explicitly calls him Rabbi Yehudah HaBasam’s son. The parallel Tosefta Chullin passage names Yehudah ben Yeshayah himself as the witness.
